Row format for [UNKNOWNS.md](../tracking/UNKNOWNS.md):

| U-### | <question, phrased so it has an answer> | <what we'd build differently depending on the answer> | <task ids / milestone> | <M?-T?? spike or Ben> | open | |

Good unknowns are answerable ("Can `claude --resume` accept a new user message non-interactively?"), not vague ("How should resume work?"). If resolving one needs more than an hour, make a spike task (M?-T?? · Spike: …) and point **Owner** at it.
